portal_description:
This advisory makes the Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.14.1 for Spring Boot available for Red Hat Integration. The purpose of this text-only errata is to inform you about the enhancements that improve your developer  experience and ensure the security and stability of your products

* Support component camel-azure-storage-datalake-starter

* Jira component error using basic authentication

* Optional AutoConfigure Actuator dependency missing in web applications

* Spring Batch doesn't register custom job bean

* Protobuf jar is not added to the classpath when exporting routes with Kamelets

* Support camel-kafka "breakOnFirstError=true" with "batching=true"

* Productize camel-debug

* Document instruction uses the un-existing artifact

* Document how to use Agroal connection pool with CSB

* Upgrade to latest Spring Boot 3.5.x version
